picks.headline: LiteLLM PyPI package compromised to execute credential theft on startup
picks.why: A supply chain attack against LiteLLM version 1.107.0 uses Python startup hooks to automatically steal credentials upon interpreter initialization.
picks.title: Inside the LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain compromise: Credential theft through Python startup hooks

picks.headline: Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro with open weights scheduled for November
picks.why: Moonshot introduced Kimi K3.1 Pro via API alongside a high-speed variant and committed to releasing open weights by November 4, 2026.
picks.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro

picks.headline: OpenAI details offline environment isolation for frontier model training
picks.why: OpenAI outlined updated security protocols for training frontier models, shifting to isolated offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.
picks.title: Securing our frontier model training environment

picks.headline: vLLM optimizes GLM-5.3 serving for 1M-token contexts on 16 H200s
picks.why: Combining Context Parallelism techniques with Hybrid HiSparse enables efficient long-context prefill and decode for 1M-token serving.
picks.title: GLM-5.3 Optimizations, Part 2: PCP, DCP, and Hybrid HiSparse on 16 H200s

picks.headline: OpenAI details Habitat storage architecture supporting 1B ChatGPT users
picks.why: Multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB integration delivered a 12x read speedup for ChatGPT online state storage.
picks.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)

picks.headline: NVIDIA TensorRT 11.1 adds Global Performance Tuner across build routes
picks.why: The tuner treats graph compilation as a global scheduling problem to automate multi-route performance tuning without sacrificing model accuracy.
picks.title: Scaling NVIDIA TensorRT Performance Optimization Beyond a Single Build Route with the Global Performance Tuner, Part 2

papers.headline: Naive RAG beats complex agentic memory in long-term conversation benchmarks
papers.why: Direct dense retrieval and reranking over raw unmutated conversation histories outperforms complex agentic memory frameworks across long-term dialogue tasks.
papers.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought

papers.headline: Reasoning models inherit pause markers from training data, not RL
papers.why: Data provenance tracing reveals that reasoning models inherit pause tokens like wait from pretraining data rather than inventing them during reinforcement learning.
papers.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models

papers.headline: Pairwise evaluation masks prompt-level scoring errors in LLM reward models
papers.why: Standard pairwise evaluations hide major prompt-level reward model errors because models over-cluster scores by prompt compared to human raters.
papers.title: What Pairwise Evaluation Misses: Reward Scores across Prompts
